cd /workspace/tmp/t && cat >> run.py <<'EOF'

def brief(name, doc):
    out = run(doc)
    print("="*70)
    print(name)
    if "error" in out:
        print("  INVALID_INPUT"); return out
    for res in out["results"]:
        print("  trace", res["id"])
        for p in res["packets"]:
            print("   pkt e%d p%d %-9s %-20s at=%s frame=%s" % (p["event"],p["packet"],p["status"],p["reason"],p["at_ms"],p["frame"]))
        print("   conn", json.dumps(res["connection"], sort_keys=True))
        print("   keys", json.dumps(res["keys"], sort_keys=True))
        print("   total", res["received_total"])
        for s in res["streams"]:
            print("   stream", json.dumps(s, sort_keys=True))
        for c in res["crypto"]:
            print("   crypto", json.dumps(c, sort_keys=True))
    return out
EOF
